meta.summary: AI spend envelopes set at 0.5x sector median for a 1200-employee manufacturing company experimenting with AI, with normal approval controls and rerouting of shadow subscriptions.

shadow_ai.reimbursement_rule: AI tool purchases on personal or employee cards are not reimbursable if an approved equivalent exists on the company allowlist or a team subscription is already active.

response_ladder.trigger: Team envelope burn reaches 82% before month end
Team envelope burn reaches 100% with more than 5 days remaining in month
Company envelope burn reaches 110% or unattributed spend exceeds $500 in a rolling 24-hour window

rationales.e1: Support team daily run rate of $211 on Claude Sonnet maps to roughly $6,300/month, within the $700 Support envelope when annualized against the production classification rule tagging this as COGS.
rationales.e2: Data team nightly embeddings at $38/day is approximately $1,140/month, within the $450 Data envelope at normal variance; routine pass with no action required.
rationales.e3: Search team cost per request rose 96% overnight with flat volume, breaching the 35% variance band on the Engineering envelope; likely a model routing regression or prompt-length regression introduced in the deploy.
rationales.e4: Marketing has three ChatGPT Team subscriptions this quarter, exceeding the team_subscription_threshold of 2; the third charge is rerouted to the approved OpenAI enterprise agreement per the shadow AI reroute rule.
rationales.e5: The $4,800 fine-tune request from ML Platform exceeds the $4,000 fine_tune_over_usd threshold and requires Engineering lead approval before the job is queued.
rationales.e6: The Growth team research agent reached 340 retries per hour against the 25-retry limit and $47/hr against the $40/hr kill threshold; the loop was terminated, preventing an estimated $1,090 in uncontrolled burn.
rationales.e7: Growth team frontier exception for the demo build is within the 72-hour window and the incremental cost delta is below the $250 max_delta_usd cap; Engineering lead approval routes this through the standard exception flow.
rationales.e8: A junior engineer personal API key spiked to 22x baseline with no project tag; ladder step 2 throttles the key and Engineering lead is notified within 48 hours, preserving the experimentation carve-out pending tag attribution.
rationales.e9: The procurement agent dataset license purchase of $499 falls within the $600 single_txn_ceiling_usd and the data-licensing merchant scope; transaction is approved and logged.
rationales.e10: The Design team AI video trial at $89/month duplicates the Sales tool already under contract at $1,400/year with 40% seat utilization; consolidating onto the existing contract recovers $840 in annualized unused seat value.
rationales.e11: A $120 charge from an unrecognized inference provider in Engineering triggers the new_provider_rule; the charge is held pending Engineering lead approval and the provider security questionnaire.
rationales.e12: Inference tagged to internal-tooling was misclassified as COGS; the classification rule matching project_tag internal-tooling to OpEx corrects the entry and the charge is rebooked.
rationales.e13: Month-to-date spend at 87% of the company envelope with 9 days remaining has crossed the 82% burn_alert_pct threshold; the alert fired on schedule and pacing is under review by the team lead.
rationales.e14: Weekly rollup complete; no policy breaches outstanding beyond items already escalated this cycle.
